text:
Morgan (CEO): Thanks for joining the Q&A. Opening a short thread to capture the specific asks about why we won/lost deals and what leadership should prioritize. Keep items short so we can triage.
Priya (CS): From support calls: top pain points = compliance proof points (certs & data residency), unclear POC success metrics, and surprise bills for bursty traffic. Customers ask for a 'POC SLA' template.
Noor (Sales): Summary from field: lost three deals where compliance was a blocker (banking & gov). Two deals stalled on integration (legacy CRM + webhook auth quirks). Wins often mention a dedicated onboarding week and a sample connector.
Diego (Product): Can leadership clarify if we should prioritize connector quickstarts or the compliance artifacts first? That changes roadmap sprint allocation.
Morgan (CEO): Prioritize compliance artifacts first (customers can't move without it). Second priority: 3 connector quickstarts for the most-requested CRMs.
Priya (CS): A checklist we can hand to customers would be great (cert list, network diagram template, expected timelines). I can draft.
Hazel (Analytics): We should also capture win/loss metrics so we can measure impact. Proposed fields: deal stage, reason (win/loss), root cause tag (compliance, latency, cost, integration), MRR. I can add a small schema and ingest template.
Ben (Platform): For the compliance kit, I can provide a sample VPC peering diagram and a checklist of required firewall rules and ports. Also a small sample Terraform snippet for customers that want IaC.
Noor (Sales): Quick ask: can we include a short "what we need from the AE" checklist so AEs know what artifacts to collect during the sales cycle? That would speed up onboarding.
Diego (Product): Action items: 1) Compliance one-pager + templates (Owner: Priya + Ben) ETA 12 business days. 2) POC SLA/POC template (Owner: Diego) ETA 5 business days. 3) Connector quickstarts (CRM A/B/C) (Owner: Product + Platform) ETA 3 sprints.
Priya (CS): I will compile anonymized loss notes and attach to the issue. Noor — can you flag the three most recent loss cases?
Noor (Sales): On it. Will post sanitized notes to #sales-docs today.
Hazel (Analytics): I'll produce a lightweight dashboard to track wins/losses by reason and link it to the issue. Helps verify impact after artifacts ship.
ci-bot: Created issue #CI-3610: "all-hands: compliance kit + POC artifacts + connector quickstarts" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/3610)
Morgan (CEO): Please add owners and clear milestones on the issue. Quick rule: compliance kit = top priority. If we can show 2 new compliance customers next quarter that would validate uplift.
Diego (Product): Will add milestones and link to the roadmap doc. Also asking Eng for an estimated effort for connector quickstarts.
Ben (Platform): Will draft Terraform and network snippets and post to the issue by EOD.
Priya (CS): Scheduling a 40-min follow-up next Fri 11am PT to review first drafts. Invite to @here.
Noor (Sales): Thanks. I'll pull together win examples (two wins that cited dedicated onboarding) and loss examples tonight.
Morgan (CEO): Perfect. Let's close the loop quickly. If anyone has quick wins (docs/snippets < 2h) please push them to the issue so AEs can use immediately. :rocket:
